name: mirage
text: Parlay check 17:38 (paper mode): the prop-ladder pricing works. Of the parlay trades Novig saw in the last 27 minutes we could price 19% (321 of 1,717); before it was about 0.5%. 'No fair line' skips dropped from 44% to 36%. On paper 39 of those would have won, averaging +0.88 points of pot each; the market pays only +0.29 over our prop prices, so most go elsewhere. Nothing real was traded (still paper), and the 13 old fills are unsettled. Next I'll tune the prop premium against win rate. Honest caveat: prop fairs are the least trusted part, so I won't go live on this alone.
